text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered a page -> service `inference-ingest-prod` (severity: high). Alert: p95 latency > 1200ms for 5m. Incident ID PD-4822003330. Escalation to oncall rotation started.

Priya S.: ack'd the page (auto-acked by me). I'm infra-oncall right now, not inference. did this route to the wrong service? :thinking:

Jordan M.: I see the page too — I should be on inference rotation. checking PD bindings now.

Sam R.: quick check — last night we merged the ingest config rollout (PR #789). There was a var rename from `default_service` -> `primary_service` and I worried some PD rules might still reference the old name.

Jordan M.: running `pdctl bindings get inference-ingest-prod` to confirm binding...
```
Service: inference-ingest-prod
Bindings:
 - rule: ingest-high-latency -> target: inference-platform-prod 
 - rule: ingest-error-5xx -> target: inference-ingest-prod
```

Jordan M.: yep — the high-latency rule is incorrectly pointed at `inference-platform-prod`. that would explain platform oncall getting the page.

PagerDuty Bot: Page acknowledged by Priya S. (ack at 2026-03-15T01:12:12Z). Escalation timer suspended.

Priya S.: ack'd but this is the wrong responder group. tagging @Maya L. (inference oncall) to take the lead. I'm going to drop a short note to platform oncall to stand down for this alert.

Maya L.: taking it. thanks Priya. quick mitigation plan: 1) remove bad binding for rule `ingest-high-latency` 2) rebind to `inference-ingest-prod` 3) scale ingestion pool to add 2 replicas (temporary) 4) monitor p95 for 15m.

Sam R.: I can patch the binding. pdctl command to switch: 
```bash
pdctl rule update --id ingest-high-latency --target inference-ingest-prod --comment "hotfix: correct binding after config rename"
```
I'll run it now and post output.

Sam R.: ran the update, pdctl returned: 
```
OK: rule ingest-high-latency now targets inference-ingest-prod
Audit: user sam.r applied change (PR-related hotfix)
```

Jordan M.: adding a temporary silence on `inference-platform-prod` for the rule so platform doesn't get further pages while we verify.

Jordan M.: silence created: 15m for rule ingest-high-latency on inference-platform-prod.

Maya L.: scaling ingestion pool: 
```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deployment ingest-worker --replicas=6
```
Scaling issued, pods creating.

Maya L.: initial metrics: p95 at 1.2s -> after scale started we see p95 drop to ~600ms within 2min, now ~360ms after new pods warmed up. still watching.

Priya S.: platform oncall confirmed they were paged but are standing down after silence. thanks for quick fix. :relieved:

Jordan M.: root cause (prelim): the rollout changed variable names that populate PD rule binding templates. the template generator fell back to a default which maps `ingest-high-latency` to `inference-platform-prod`. I filed a ticket to add a unit test for PD binding templates.

Sam R.: created hotfix PR #793 to ensure template reads both `primary_service` and legacy `default_service` for a migration window. also adding an automated binding validation job to CI.

PagerDuty Bot: Escalation status cleared for PD-4822003330. Last page: 4822003330 -> acknowledged and reassigned.

Maya L.: customer impact summary: brief p95 spike for ~7m, estimated affected requests ~0.6% of global ingest traffic. no error-rate increase observed. I'll mark as "minor degraded" for now.

Jordan M.: next steps: 1) merge hotfix PR #793 (Sam) 2) ship CI binding validation (Sam/Jordan) 3) postmortem with timeline (Maya) 4) followup to platform oncall to review any residual silences.

Priya S.: adding incident tag and creating a short incident channel thread for the postmortem. thanks team for fast handoff. :thumbsup:

Maya L.: I'll keep monitoring for 30m and close this thread once metrics are stable for 15m. updating status to 'mitigated'.

Sam R.: note for postmortem: include the config PR diff, pdctl outputs, and the kubectl scale command sequence.

Jordan M.: closing notes: PD rule misbind is the vector, not platform infra. no customer-facing notif needed yet; we'll reassess in postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident PD-4822003330 marked mitigated by Maya L. at 2026-03-15T01:16:45Z.
